Rate the photograph on cuteness. L: decidedly uncute; M: neither cute nor uncute; H: exceptionally cute. Reply with only L, M, or H.
Rate the photograph on scary. L: actively reassuring; M: neither scary nor reassuring; H: frightening. Reply with only L, M, or H.
Rate the photograph on funny. L: decidedly serious; M: neither funny nor serious; H: distinctly amusing. Reply with only L, M, or H.
Rate the photograph on activity. L: resting or motionless; M: alert or gently engaged; H: vigorous movement. Reply with only L, M, or H.
Rate the photograph on crowding. L: isolated forms with open space; M: some surrounding detail; H: many competing or overlapping details. Reply with only L, M, or H.
Rate the photograph on color_intensity. L: muted or monochrome; M: moderate color; H: strong saturated colors. Reply with only L, M, or H.
